title: SSOT Validation Patterns and Standards
subtitle: Validation rules, patterns, and best practices for SSOT YAML files
icon: ✅

# Purpose: Define validation patterns and standards for SSOT YAML files
# This SSOT file serves as the central repository for validation rules
ideas:
  - Ensure consistency across all SSOT YAML files
  - Provide clear validation rules for different SSOT file types
  - Document best practices for SSOT file structure and content
  - Enable automated validation with clear error messages
  - Support hostname compliance enforcement
  - Maintain cross-file consistency validation

# Validation rule categories
validation_categories:
  - title: Required Fields
    icon: 📋
    description: Fields that must be present in SSOT files
    rules:
      - label: Standard SSOT Files
        text: All standard SSOT files must have a title field
        applies_to: [standard-ssot]
        exceptions: [config-type, apps-subdirectory]

      - label: Section Structure
        text: Files with sections must have title, icon, and layout fields
        applies_to: [standard-ssot]
        exceptions: [config-type]

      - label: Item Structure
        text: Section items must have label and text fields
        applies_to: [standard-ssot]
        exceptions: []

  - title: YAML Syntax
    icon: 🔧
    description: YAML syntax and structure validation
    rules:
      - label: Valid YAML
        text: All SSOT files must be valid YAML syntax
        applies_to: [all]
        exceptions: []

      - label: No Trailing Whitespace
        text: Lines should not have trailing whitespace
        applies_to: [all]
        exceptions: []

      - label: Consistent Indentation
        text: Use consistent 2-space indentation for YAML
        applies_to: [all]
        exceptions: []

  - title: Content Consistency
    icon: 🔗
    description: Cross-file and internal consistency validation
    rules:
      - label: No Duplicate Section Titles
        text: Section titles within a file must be unique
        applies_to: [standard-ssot]
        exceptions: []

      - label: No Duplicate Item Labels
        text: Item labels within a section must be unique
        applies_to: [standard-ssot]
        exceptions: []

      - label: Cross-Reference Consistency
        text: References to other SSOT files must be valid
        applies_to: [all]
        exceptions: []

  - title: Hostname Compliance
    icon: 🌐
    description: Network hostname standards enforcement
    rules:
      - label: Use .local Hostnames
        text: Use .local hostnames instead of IP addresses
        applies_to: [all]
        exceptions: [health-check, network-documentation]

      - label: Standard Hostname Format
        text: Use format hostname.local (e.g. tony-omen.local)
        applies_to: [all]
        exceptions: []

      - label: No IP Addresses
        text: Avoid hardcoded IP addresses (use ranges in documentation only)
        applies_to: [all]
        exceptions: [health-check, subnet-documentation]

  - title: File Naming
    icon: 📁
    description: SSOT file naming conventions
    rules:
      - label: SSOT Prefix
        text: SSOT files must start with 'ssot.' prefix
        applies_to: [all]
        exceptions: [template]

      - label: Descriptive Names
        text: File names should be descriptive and follow kebab-case
        applies_to: [all]
        exceptions: []

      - label: Category Organization
        text: Files should be organized in appropriate subdirectories
        applies_to: [all]
        exceptions: []

# File type classifications
file_types:
  - title: Standard SSOT Files
    icon: 📄
    pattern: ssot.*.yml
    validation: strict
    required_fields: [title, sections]
    optional_fields: [subtitle, icon, ideas, config]

  - title: Configuration-Type Files
    icon: ⚙️
    pattern: ssot.(health|gpu|services|apps).yml
    validation: flexible
    required_fields: []
    optional_fields: [all]

  - title: Apps Subdirectory Files
    icon: 📱
    pattern: apps/ssot.apps.*.yml
    validation: data-only
    required_fields: []
    optional_fields: [all]

  - title: Template Files
    icon: 📋
    pattern: template.yml
    validation: none
    required_fields: []
    optional_fields: [all]

# Validation patterns
validation_patterns:
  - title: Standard SSOT Structure
    icon: 🏗️
    pattern: |
      title: Required
      subtitle: Optional
      icon: Optional emoji
      ideas: Optional list of ideas/notes
      sections:
        - title: Required
          icon: Required emoji
          layout: list|grid|timeline
          items:
            - label: Required
              text: Required
              status: Optional (active|completed|pending)
              priority: Optional (high|medium|low)
              tags: Optional array
              dependencies: Optional array
    applies_to: [standard-ssot]

  - title: Configuration Structure
    icon: ⚙️
    pattern: |
      # Flexible structure for config-type files
      # Can include any fields relevant to the configuration
      key: value
      nested:
        key: value
    applies_to: [config-type]

  - title: Apps Data Structure
    icon: 📱
    pattern: |
      # Simple data structure for application configurations
      app_name:
        url: string
        description: string
        status: string
    applies_to: [apps-subdirectory]

# Error messages and resolutions
error_patterns:
  - title: Missing Required Field
    error: "Missing required field: {field}"
    resolution: "Add the missing field to the SSOT file"
    severity: error

  - title: Invalid YAML Syntax
    error: "Invalid YAML syntax: {details}"
    resolution: "Fix YAML syntax errors (indentation, quotes, colons)"
    severity: error

  - title: Duplicate Entry
    error: "Duplicate {entry_type}: {value}"
    resolution: "Remove or rename the duplicate entry"
    severity: error

  - title: Hostname Violation
    error: "IP address found: {ip} (should use .local hostname)"
    resolution: "Replace IP address with .local hostname"
    severity: warning

  - title: Cross-Reference Error
    error: "Invalid reference: {reference}"
    resolution: "Ensure the referenced file or section exists"
    severity: error

# Validation workflow
validation_workflow:
  - title: Pre-Validation
    icon: 🔍
    steps:
      - Check file exists and is readable
      - Verify file naming conventions
      - Determine file type classification
      - Load appropriate validation rules

  - title: Syntax Validation
    icon: 🔧
    steps:
      - Parse YAML syntax
      - Check for structural errors
      - Validate indentation consistency
      - Check for trailing whitespace

  - title: Content Validation
    icon: 📋
    steps:
      - Validate required fields present
      - Check field data types
      - Validate enum values (status, priority, layout)
      - Check for duplicate entries

  - title: Consistency Validation
    icon: 🔗
    steps:
      - Check internal consistency (duplicates, references)
      - Validate cross-file references
      - Check hostname compliance
      - Compare with served/public copies

  - title: Post-Validation
    icon: ✅
    steps:
      - Generate validation report
      - Categorize issues by severity
      - Provide resolution suggestions
      - Return exit code based on results

# Best practices
best_practices:
  - title: File Organization
    icon: 📁
    practices:
      - Keep related SSOT files in the same directory
      - Use subdirectories for logical grouping (infrastructure, apps, etc.)
      - Maintain template.yml for new file creation
      - Archive old versions rather than deleting

  - title: Content Structure
    icon: 📝
    practices:
      - Use clear, descriptive titles
      - Include helpful subtitles for context
      - Use relevant emojis for visual organization
      - Document ideas and future plans in ideas section

  - title: Maintenance
    icon: 🔄
    practices:
      - Run validation before committing changes
      - Update related files when making changes
      - Keep validation patterns up to date
      - Review and archive outdated entries

  - title: Collaboration
    icon: 👥
    practices:
      - Use clear field names and values
      - Include comments for complex logic
      - Document exceptions to validation rules
      - Maintain change history in config section

# Configuration and metadata
config:
  version: 1
  last_updated: 2026-08-05
  maintainer: tony
  validation_enabled: true
  related_files:
    - scripts/validate-configs.sh
    - scripts/generate-mcp-configs.py
    - scripts/validate-focus.mjs
    - scripts/ssot-validate-refs.py
    - docs/ssot/template.yml

# Cross-reference (ref) contract
ref_contract:
  purpose: |
    Define how SSOT files reference each other so that a CI validator can
    resolve the pointers and fail on broken links.
  recognized_keys:
    - ref
    - source_ref
    - allowed_values_ref
    - default_ref
    - defaults_ref
    - state_ref
    - currencies_ref
    - selected_currency_ref
    - timeframe_ref
    - chart_type_ref
    - features_ref
    - scripts_ref
    - "*_ref" # any key ending in _ref is considered a reference
  syntax:
    cross_file: "ssot.file.yml#dotted.key.path"
    same_file: "dotted.key.path"
    external: "/absolute/path.yml#key" # not validated by the SSOT ref checker
    placeholder: "... or <...>" # ignored by the validator
  conventions:
    - A reference without a .yml, /, #, or dot is treated as an ID and not validated.
    - References to docs/ssot/ files may omit the docs/ssot/ prefix.
    - References to external repo files (e.g., docs/kb/...) are validated for existence when the path starts with docs/, reports/, scripts/.
  ci:
    command: "python3 scripts/ssot-validate-refs.py"
    workflow: ".github/workflows/ssot.yml"

# Job Title

One-line description of the critical or optimization job

## File Path
`templates/job.yml`

## YAML Content
```yaml
# SSOT Job Lifecycle Template
# Copy this file to docs/ssot/jobs/<type>/<YYYY-MM-DD-short-name>.yml
# and fill in all four lifecycle sections before starting the job.

title: Job Title
subtitle: One-line description of the critical or optimization job
icon: target

# Planning: define the job before any processing starts.
planning:
  goal: What we want to achieve
  scope: What is in scope and what is explicitly out of scope
  success_criteria:
    - Measurable outcome 1
    - Measurable outcome 2
  risks:
    - Risk and mitigation 1
    - Risk and mitigation 2
  resources:
    - Host/tool/data dependency 1
  owner: tony
  estimated_duration: 1 session
  related_focus:
    - label: Focus label
      file: docs/ssot/ssot.focus.current.yml

# Processing: append steps, decisions, and changes as work happens.
processing:
  status: not_started
  started_at: null
  steps:
    - id: 1
      label: Step one
      status: not_started
      notes: Details or commands
  decisions:
    - label: Decision one
      rationale: Why this choice was made
      alternatives_considered: What was rejected and why
  changes:
    - file: path/to/changed.file
      summary: What changed

# Followup: verify, rollback, handoff.
followup:
  verification:
    - Command or check that proves success
    - Manual review step
  rollback_plan:
    - Command or procedure to undo the change if needed
  handoff:
    - Next owner or system that takes over
  deferred:
    - Items intentionally left for later

# Report: close the job and feed the KB.
report:
  status: not_started
  completed_at: null
  summary: What was done and why
  metrics:
    - metric: value
  links:
    - title: Commit/PR/artifact
      url: /path/or/url
    - title: Related focus
      file: docs/ssot/ssot.focus.current.yml
  kb_review:
    - Decision or discovery worth KB
  lessons_learned:
    - What to do differently next time

config:
  version: 1
  created_at: 2026-08-18
  last_updated: 2026-08-18
  maintainer: tony
  related_files:
    - docs/ssot/templates/job.yml

```
